Compensation proceedings of Adolf Rosenberg: assets and properties in Ahlen

Included: booklet “Everything about Permadry. Vitamin A in the fat capsule,” published by Stabilized Vitamins Inc., Brooklyn 31, N.Y. [Adolf Rosenberg’s company]; correspondence with the Westphalian Central Cooperative concerning Permadry and a possible business arrangement.

Contains: judgment and order fixing costs by Beckum District Court concerning claims by Philipp Rosenberg, Ahlen, against a defendant in Oelde, 1934; land-register entries in Walstedde, Oelde, and Ahlen; security-transfer agreement between Philipp Rosenberg’s company and a bakery in Ahlen, 1933; letters from Adolf Rosenberg to Franz Branse concerning reimbursement claims in Ahlen; correspondence between Rosenberg’s lawyers in Ahlen and New York; schedule of compensation claims; questionnaire and letters from the Higher Regional Finance Directorate; correspondence with Adolf Rosenberg, Karl (Charles) Rosenberg, and lawyer Josef Rolf, Ahlen.
